en.headline: WIPO pledges deeper IP cooperation as Hong Kong expands financing and patent review
en.dek: At the Business of IP Asia Forum, the UN agency said it would help the city on dispute resolution and commercialisation while the finance chief outlined plans for a regional trading centre.
body: The World Intellectual Property Organization has pledged to deepen cooperation with Hong Kong on dispute resolution, education and commercialisation.

Shen Changyu, deputy director general of WIPO, spoke at the Business of IP Asia Forum on Thursday. He said the agency stood ready to help Hong Kong use intellectual property to advance its ambitions in finance, trade and technology.

Beijing has positioned Hong Kong as a regional intellectual property trading centre in China’s 15th five-year plan. The city’s government plans to expand a pilot scheme for lending backed by intangible assets.

Financial Secretary Paul Chan said at the same forum that the current task is to scale up the IP Financing Sandbox launched with the Hong Kong Monetary Authority last December. The first batch of seven loans has been approved.

He added that a new pilot scheme will help small and medium-sized enterprises obtain professional patent valuations according to national standards. Hong Kong is also expanding its patent review team, with a target of self-reviewing patent applications in major technology fields by 2030.

Chan said the Patent Box tax concession allows eligible IP profits to be taxed at 5 per cent, and a bill before the Legislative Council would broaden tax deductions for purchasing and licensing overseas intellectual property.

zh.headline: 世界知識產權組織深化與港合作 陳茂波推融資及專利審查
zh.dek: 在亞洲知識產權營商論壇上，聯合國機構表示願協助本港處理爭議解決及商業化，財政司司長則闡述建設區域貿易中心的計劃。
body: 世界知識產權組織承諾深化與香港在爭議解決、教育及商業化方面的合作。
世界知識產權組織副總幹事申長雨周四在亞洲知識產權營商論壇發言。他表示機構願意協助香港利用知識產權推進其在金融、貿易及科技方面的抱負。
國家「十五五」規劃支持香港建設成為區域知識產權貿易中心。特區政府計劃擴大以無形資產作抵押的借貸先導計劃。
財政司司長陳茂波在同一論壇表示，目前任務是將去年12月與金管局推出的知識產權融資沙盒規模化。首批七筆貸款已獲批。
他補充，一項新的先導計劃將協助中小企按照國家標準為專利取得專業估值。香港亦正擴大專利審查員團隊，目標是於2030年前自行審查主要科技領域的專利申請。
陳茂波說，「專利盒」稅務優惠讓合資格的知識產權利潤按5%課稅，立法會正審議的法案將擴闊購買及特許使用外地知識產權的稅務扣減。
